title: Plasma USDT Locked Product: Final Batch Opens With a 500M USDT Quota (Limited Time & Quota)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians,   Binance Earn is excited to announce the  Final Batch 3 Quota for Binance On-Chain Yields’  Plasma USDT Locked Product , with a Subscription Limit of 500,000,000 USDT  starting from  2025-08-26 11:00 (UTC) . This comes after the overwhelming responses for the  Initial Plasma USDT Locked Product Launch  and  Batch 2 Quota Launch  with their Subscription Limits  fully subscribed within minutes! To maintain sustainability and fairness across the entire subscription pool, please note the following: Subscription Limit per user  for the Final Batch 3 Quota has been lowered to  10,000 USDT.  Binance may gradually adjust the quota based on the market demand and other reasons. Active positions of users who subscribed in previous batches will remain unaffected. After this Final Batch 3 Quota, there will be  no further opening of new batches  nor  increases to the Total Subscription Limit. About Total Subscription Limit & Quota Batches: Binance reserves the right to adjust any product parameters, and any adjustments may be announced separately.  Please note that due to the increase in  Total Subscription Limit  and  opening of new Quota Batches  as per the   last announcement ,  XPL Rewards (Post TGE)  may fluctuate to maintain sustainability and fairness across the entire subscription pool. The  daily USDT rewards  per user remain the same. Early redemptions  will not  result in any loss of USDT and XPL accrued rewards. Allocations are available on a  first-come, first-served basis . Subscription Limits and other product parameters apply. All other product rules,  except for the Total Subscription Limit,  from the  Plasma USDT Locked Product Launch Announcement  still apply. Please refer to the respective  subscription page ,  Plasma USDT Locked Product Rules , and   FAQ  for more details. How to Get Started with Plasma USDT Locked Product on On-Chain Yields: Website Step 1:  Click on [ Earn ] on the top navigation menu.  Step 2:  Navigate to [ Advanced Earn ] > [ On-Chain Yields ]. Step 3:  Click on [Subscribe] and confirm your stake amount and estimated rewards.  App Step 1:  Tap on [More] on the App homepage. Step 2:  Go to [ Earn ] > [ On-Chain Yields ]. Step 3:  Choose your preferred portfolio and tap [Subscribe] to get started. Subscribe USDT Now About Binance On-Chain Yields: Binance On-Chain Yields  allows users to easily participate in various on-chain protocols and earn tokens, points, and other rewards directly through their Binance account. With On-Chain Yields, users can explore high-yield opportunities within Binance without performing complex on-chain setups or operations. Please Note: Product launches on Binance Earn and Binance listings are independent and not correlated. Inclusion of any tokens in Binance Earn products does not guarantee their listings on any Binance markets. Furthermore, the launch of Earn products does not imply any endorsement or guarantee of other product launches, integrations or listings on Binance related to the associated protocols or tokens. Product rewards are provided and sourced from on-chain protocols, where necessary. During the subscription period, users who are restricted due to account, regulatory & other unforeseeable reasons under any scenario  will not receive XPL rewards . Binance reserves the right to withdraw any airdropped XPL rewards to ensure the platform’s safety for our users. Changes to the On-Chain Yields Rewards Rate will be published on the Platform from time to time. Please refer to   On-Chain Yields Terms ,  Terms of Use , and  Risk Warning  for more information prior to using On-Chain Yields. Users may view their Locked Products subscriptions by going to Assets > Earn > Staking >  On-Chain Yields . Early redemptions may be delayed due to exceptional circumstances, such as extreme market volatility, network outages, protocol failures, or a high volume of simultaneous redemption requests. For more information on associated risks, please refer to the risk warning. On-Chain Yields is a high-risk product with no guarantee of principal or returns. It involves risks such as smart contract vulnerabilities, market volatility, protocol failure, and other potential risks. Users bear these risks independently, and Binance is not liable for losses from on-chain protocols.  The terms and conditions from the  Batch 1  and  Batch 2  subscription continue to apply.
